dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: ...Now that's rare. People wanting me to start a conversation is a rather infrequent occurrence.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: After all, in most cases, this would just mean falling into an uncomfortable silence like this.

choices.text: Do you not like to chat?

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: No, that's not it. You can often find me talking with other girls.

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: They often gossip about the latest issues of serialized novels, or the gossip on who has a crush on whom...

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: Just say "Oh, I see", "Wow, really?", or "Go on!" at the right moment... and the conversation will flow freely.

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: ...It's a great way to conserve your energy. I highly recommend it.

choices.text: Well, if you don't talk, then silence is inevitable...

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: Saying something requires first listening, then analyzing, constructing your idea, and finally speaking out loud.

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: A back-and-forth conversation would require me to go through all the steps very efficiently. Mm... I've always found it quite taxing.

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: ...Also, is it not true some people prefer to chat with someone who listens more than they talk?

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: If you ever have something to vent about, feel free to come and confide in me. I have a lot of experience in comforting others and calming things down.

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: Also, you can rest assured that your secrets will always be safe with me.
